Third person singular -s · 要点精讲: Present simple with third person singular subjects: the verb changes, add -s/-es to the base form.本课为要点精讲练习,核心:When he/she/it or a singular noun is the subject, the verb adds -s/-es。

Most verbs add -s: reads, works|Those ending in s/x/ch/sh add -es: watches, washes|Consonant + y changes y to i and adds -es: studies|have changes specially to has|The negative is doesn't + base verb (not doesn'ts)
She reades books every night.|She reading books every night.|She reads books every night.|She read books every night.
column4: 考查When he/she/it or a singular noun is the subject, the verb adds -s/-es。正确句:She reads books every night.
